GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Search Builder: plain English to saved-search criteria JSON.

templateVersions.content:
Convert the request into JSON search criteria for Nexus Pursuit Hub. Return only a JSON object, no prose. Allowed keys: keywords (boolean expression with AND, OR, NOT, quotes, trailing *), agencies (array of agency names as in SAM.gov paths), naics (array, prefix with *), psc, setAsides (array of: Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, Service-Disabled, Women-Owned), noticeTypes (array of: Pre-solicitation, Sources Sought, Solicitation, Combined Synopsis/Solicitation, Award Notice, Special Notice, RFI, Grant, Task Order), minValue, maxValue (numbers in dollars), dueWithinDays, postedWithinDays (integers), minFit (0-100). Omit any key the request does not mention.
Request: {!$Input:Request}
